caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent glass object resembling a candlestick or goblet set against a plain, beige background. The object has a wide, circular top with a thick rim, narrowing down into a straight cylindrical neck. This neck sits atop a bulbous, rounded midsection, which is supported by a series of flat, circular rings. The lower part of the object flares outward and downward, transitioning into a broad, elaborately decorated base. The base displays repeated oval and teardrop-shaped patterns, giving it a textured and ornate appearance. The illustration is rendered in shades of grey and black, using fine lines and subtle shading to create the appearance of clear glass and to emphasize the reflective and transparent properties of the material. The central placement of the object and lack of additional elements focus attention solely on the detailed depiction of the glass form.
title: Candlestick
